card.name: Small words before stomach or gut terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, from, in) right before a word like stomach or gastrointestinal tract, mostly in overdose advice about emptying the stomach or removing unabsorbed drug.

modes.label: Emptying the stomach
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'Empty' or 'empty', just before 'stomach'.
modes.example: In the event of acute overdosage, reversible renal toxicity has been reported in some cases. Empty<< the>> stomach by inducing vomiting or by gastric lav

modes.label: Removing unabsorbed material
modes.description: 'from' or 'the' after 'unabsorbed material' or 'removal of drug', just before gastrointestinal tract or stomach.
modes.example: The usual measures to remove unabsorbed material<< from>> the gastrointestinal tract, clinical monitoring, and

modes.label: Food found in diet
modes.description: The word 'in' before 'diet' in a description of what an animal eats.
modes.example: Insects reported<< in>> diet include beetles, leaf hoppers

card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text names the stomach or gut, as in overdose instructions.
